message.content:
This is a screenshot of the **Render** web application (specifically the "Create a new Blueprint Instance" page within "My Workspace"). Render is a cloud platform for hosting web services, databases, and other applications.

## Page Header
- **Title:** "Create a new **Blueprint** Instance in **My Workspace**" (with "Blueprint" and "My Workspace" in purple text)
- **Subtitle:** "Connect your Git repository or use an existing public repository URL."

## Main Content Area (Left Side)
A section titled **"Connect a repository"** containing:

1. **Search Bar:**
   - Placeholder text: "Search"
   - Magnifying glass icon on the left

2. **Repository List (6 repositories visible):**
   Each entry shows:
   - Git icon (circular arrow)
   - Repository name (format: `owner/repo-name`)
   - Time since last update
   - White **"Connect"** button on the right

   The visible repositories are:
   - `rudeeh / init-mcp-server` • 13 minutes ago
   - `rudeeh / p2p-fl-robustness` • 4 days ago
   - `rudeeh / Papercraft` • 9 days ago
   - `AnshulPatil2005 / docRAG_v3` • 20 days ago
   - `rudeeh / Kairos` • a month ago
   - `rudeeh / IDP` • 6 months ago

## Sidebar (Right Side)
Shows connected Git provider accounts:

### GitHub Section
- **GitHub logo + "GitHub" header**
- Connected accounts:
  - **@rudeeh** (external link icon) • 5 repos
  - **@AnshulPatil2005** (external link icon) • 1 repo
- **"Configure account"** link with settings icon

### GitLab Section
- **GitLab logo + "GitLab" header**
- **"Connect account +"** link (not currently connected)

### Bitbucket Section
- **Bitbucket logo + "Bitbucket" header**
- **"Connect account +"** link (not currently connected)

## Current State
The user is at the **repository selection step** of creating a new Blueprint Instance. They have two GitHub accounts connected (@rudeeh with 5 repos and @AnshulPatil2005 with 1 repo), and can see a list of available repositories to connect. No repository is currently selected—the user needs to click one of the "Connect" buttons or search for a specific repository to proceed.

**Visual Style:** Dark theme with black background, white text, purple accent colors for headings/links, and light gray borders around input fields and list items.
